scripts.dev: concurrently --names "NEXT,CHAT" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix eduspark" "npm run dev --prefix eduspark-chat-server"
scripts.build: npm --prefix eduspark run build && npm --prefix eduspark-chat-server run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix eduspark && npm install --prefix eduspark-chat-server
scripts.db:generate: npm --prefix eduspark run db:generate && npm --prefix eduspark-chat-server run db:generate
scripts.infra:reset: docker compose -f eduspark-infra/docker-compose.yml down -v && docker compose -f eduspark-infra/docker-compose.yml up -d
